summary: Full backend + frontend regression of the 'Monta tu grupo' viral loop (Fase A). Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass — POST /api/groups, GET /api/groups/{id}/invite (returns {code, group_name, url=https://quienva.me/?g=CODE}), POST /api/me/claim-group-invite (auto-join + auto-friend + both notifications), idempotency (already_member=true, no duplicated membership), 403 for non-member on /invite, 404 for unknown code. Frontend: 4/4 flows pass — (1) opening /?g=CODE persists qv_pending_group in localStorage; (2) registering a NEW user via UI at /login?g=CODE auto-joins the group after signup (GET /api/groups shows TEST_UIGroup) and clears qv_pending_group; (3) onboarding-invite step is reached by tapping onboarding-next through slides+privacy+notif, GroupInviteStep renders with group-name-input + group-invite-whatsapp + group-invite-share + group-invite-copy, typing a name and pressing Copy triggers POST /api/groups + GET /api/groups/{id}/invite (200) and shows group-created banner; (4) for a fresh user with no groups/friends, /feed (with qv_discover_seen=1 to bypass the one-time /descubrir redirect) renders the monta-grupo-banner + monta-grupo-open, tapping expands GroupInviteStep inline with monta-grupo-close, close hides the banner. FindFriends component renders inside onboarding invite step (data-testid=find-friends) with connect-contacts-btn present; contacts-search-input is gated behind a real Contact Picker scan which is unavailable in headless — confirmed no render error.

design_issues.screen: Feed (first visit for users with 0 friends)
issues: Feed.js redirects new users once to /descubrir (via qv_discover_seen), which HIDES the MontaGrupoBanner on the very first landing. The banner is only reachable when the user comes back to /feed. Consider showing the banner on /descubrir too or delaying the auto-redirect until after the banner is dismissed, otherwise the viral entry point on Feed is invisible for the first session.

PushPermissionGate ('Turn on notifications' modal) covers the whole feed before the user has interacted — banner is not visible until the modal is dismissed. Consider only showing the push gate AFTER the user creates/joins a group so the viral banner is not hidden.
/icons/icon-512.png preload warning persists (carried over from iteration 9) — either drop the <link rel=preload> or add correct 'as' value.

action_items: Consider gating the /descubrir first-visit redirect so the MontaGrupoBanner on /feed is discoverable in the first session (viral entry point is currently hidden for new users).
Consider delaying the PushPermissionGate until after the user has interacted with the Monta-Grupo banner so it's not obscured on first paint.
(Nice-to-have) Return a stable copy toast even when navigator.clipboard.writeText throws — the copyLink swallows the error silently.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::claim_group_invite reads member_ids BEFORE $addToSet, then loops those members for friendships/notifs and skips the newcomer for the 'joined-your-group' broadcast (mid != uid). Correct today, but if any concurrent claim occurs the same code re-uses the pre-fetched `members` list — safe because the newcomer id is excluded — no bug, just fragile.

server.py::_ensure_group_invite_code has a race: two concurrent GET /invite calls on a code-less group can each generate different codes; the second update_one overwrites the first. Rare, but consider find_one_and_update with upsert-like semantics or a unique index on invite_code.

Frontend App.js runs the claim effect whenever `user` becomes truthy AND qv_pending_group is set. If the API is slow the user may already be navigated to /onboarding when the claim resolves, and the toast fires on a non-feed screen. UX is fine (still shown) but the effect could also fire twice on quick auth changes — a small `useRef(inFlight)` guard would harden it.

GroupInviteStep.copyLink swallows clipboard errors silently — no toast, no fallback text — on iOS/Safari without clipboard permission the user gets no feedback. Consider falling back to shareGroupInvite or a manual copy modal.
Feed.js one-time /descubrir redirect for users with 0 friends effectively hides the Monta-Grupo banner on the first (and highest-intent) visit.
test_credentials: N/A — tests register fresh TEST_ prefixed users each run via POST /api/auth/register with @example.com emails (the app rejects .test TLD). Backend rate-limits registration (429) after ~4 rapid registrations from the same IP.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates 3 TEST_viral_* users and 1 TEST_ViralGroup per run. Frontend playwright run created ~5 TEST_* users, 1 TEST_UIGroup, 1 TEST_MyOnbGroup2. All prefixed TEST_ for easy cleanup; nothing else touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend viral loop is solid — reuse /app/backend/tests/test_group_viral_loop.py (run with `-o addopts=''` if xdist parallelism causes email-uniqueness collisions on the module-scope fixtures). For frontend, three gotchas: (a) POST /api/auth/register rejects .test TLD (needs @example.com); (b) rate-limit kicks in around 4 rapid registrations — space them out ≥15s; (c) new users with 0 friends get a one-time redirect to /descubrir on first /feed visit — pre-set localStorage.qv_discover_seen='1' before goto('/feed') to test the MontaGrupoBanner. The PushPermissionGate overlay is dismissible via clicking the 'Continue anyway' link.
rca of the issue: Initial TEST3 flake (group not created after copy click) was caused by a 3.5s wait that was shorter than the two sequential API calls (POST /groups then GET /invite) on the preview URL. Extending the wait to ≥5s makes the flow deterministic. Root cause was test timing, not application code.
